explication: LeetCodeAnimation is a curated learning repository for algorithm explanations. A learner discovers a problem through the numbered or topic index, selects a problem, and consumes its article, animation, or reference implementation; the website provides the richer interactive playback experience. The repository also maintains structured manifest data and synchronizes website changes back into GitHub. Sampled source confirms the animation scaffolding model and representative Java solutions, but not the website implementation, so those relationships remain external or conservative.
